title: The practice environment and isolated rehearsal flow are not implemented

original_titles.title: Practice environment capability missing for all four roles

problem: The repository contains the live event flow but no separate namespaced practice API/UI/database schema. The four-level flow and code runner are separate from practice mode. This is not shown as an active runtime feature.
impact: Participants cannot rehearse the real workspace and submission path without touching production event state. A separate practice system would reduce onboarding errors but creates another isolation boundary to maintain.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Decide whether practice is a launch requirement or an explicit out-of-scope item for this event. Do not silently expose production GT to make a practice copy.
If built, create separate practice event/challenge namespaces, synthetic users and separate GT schema or tenant-level isolation.
Use immediate feedback only in practice. Add tests proving production submissions, scores, flags and GT are unreachable from practice endpoints.
Add a practice navigation/entry page and provide a resettable seed dataset that cannot mutate live event records.

acceptance_criteria: Owner signs either a scope waiver or acceptance criteria.
If implemented, automated tests prove no practice-to-production IDOR or score mutation.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.

residual_risk_or_scope_note: This can be deferred if the event onboarding plan provides a supervised dry run and the waiver is explicit.
